protocol.feature: mean of min(mode0 train R, mode1 train R) times train DD circular concentration across six windows
protocol.target: held-pilot minus training-pilot circular dwell mean; noisy internal agreement, not geometric phase error
protocol.model: kappa=8*sigmoid(a+b*x), b>=0; weak fixed ridge; equal scan weight; one dwell per sample
protocol.evaluation: all selected long-overlap dwells; held-pilot phase only; same CFO banks/folds/shortlists as timing trial
